default_views_scope.name: default_views_scope
default_views_scope.value: ("default_views"."scope" = 'org' and "default_views"."user_id" is null and "default_views"."group_id" is null) or ("default_views"."scope" = 'group' and "default_views"."group_id" is not null and "default_views"."user_id" is null) or ("default_views"."scope" in ('user','personal') and "default_views"."user_id" is not null and "default_views"."group_id" is null)

tags_name_format.name: tags_name_format
tags_name_format.value: "tags"."name" glob '[a-z0-9]*' and "tags"."name" not glob '*[^a-z0-9_]*' and length("tags"."name") <= 40
